title: NovaRTP
description: A modern Paper 1.21.11 Random Teleport plugin with a GUI for Overworld, Nether and End. Configurable dimensions, min/max radius support and safe teleportation.
body:
# NovaRTP

NovaRTP is a lightweight and modern Random Teleport (RTP) plugin for Paper 1.21.11 servers.

## Features

* GUI-based RTP menu
* Overworld RTP
* Nether RTP
* End RTP
* Enable or disable dimensions in config
* Configurable minimum radius
* Configurable maximum radius
* Safe teleport location detection
* Lava protection
* Water protection
* Lightweight and optimized

## Command

```
/rtp
```

## Permission

```
novartp.use
```

## Configuration

```yaml
dimensions:
  overworld:
    enabled: true
    min-radius: 1000
    max-radius: 5000

  nether:
    enabled: true
    min-radius: 500
    max-radius: 3000

  end:
    enabled: true
    min-radius: 1000
    max-radius: 4000
```

## Requirements

* Paper 1.21.11+
* Java 21
